notes: Clean beyond the known ledger: every server-chunk defect I could substantiate matches an open known.json row (BLK-5, BLK-54, MAJ-2, MAJ-5-r2, MAJ-6, MAJ-7, MAJ-53, MAJ-66, MAJ-67, MIN-3, MIN-68, NIT-4). The repos_index.html name-input title (English, 'registry'/'mining folder' jargon, visible to casual users) was dropped as a trivial variant of MAJ-53 (same Projekte add form, same file). Cross-chunk for the station: (1) handleProfileSave runs skills.Sync after writing s.presentation.path, but sync_skills.sh reads the audience from the fixed ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md — with a non-default -presentation flag the flip reads a different file (cmd/sync, unverified here); (2) BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT is rejected only for quotes and \n, not \r or shell metacharacters — safety depends on how cmd/bootstrap/run.sh quotes it; (3) Repo.Validate label cap and reserved names live in internal/repos. Test files were not read. No spec traces were found for the run-history Result/RUNNING cells, Unscheduled routine rendering or the routineSession -cells prefix match, but spec-11 treats the Result cell and the refresh/filter UI as existing baseline, so I did not raise concept-audit findings for them.

walk.answer: Server side: presentationStore is the single profile source (presentation.go), langAttr/t/isDeveloperAudience drive layout.html; casual nav hides engine tabs; proposal card hides target/band/tags/gate row and collapses snippets as 'technical detail'; gating is render-time only (no forked handlers). Remaining translation gaps are already in the known ledger (MAJ-53, MAJ-66, MAJ-67, BLK-54). Items 2-5 are outside the server chunk.

Casual nav/headings German via t; internal pages hidden from nav; card surface reduced; snippets marked 'Technisches Detail'. Known ledger already carries the residual English/jargon leaks (repos op output BLK-54, _repo_path literals MAJ-53, stateNote suffix MAJ-66, permissions kind MAJ-67). Items 13/16 are nightly/pipeline, out of chunk.
loadPresentationProfile fails open (absent file, no front matter, empty language -> en; non-casual audience -> developer). Hook/run.sh/install/Windows items are outside the server chunk.

DefaultPresentationPath exported; FuncMap t/langAttr/isDeveloperAudience; translate identity fallback; html lang from profile; nav gating per item 29; casual overview renders session tiles + proposals tile with {{t .Label}}; card hides target/band/tags/gate row and shows translated snippet label; card controls wrapped in t with catalog entries (verified every {{t "..."}} key in templates exists in germanCatalog).

Canonical group titles stay verbatim and translate at render via {{t .Title}} on category/group/subgroup; proposals.html wraps kind heading, 'updated', 'Everything applied, happy', 'file(s) failed to load:'; vote tooltips use translated format keys; overview signalDetail/delta translated, window labels {{t .Label}}; catalog holds the canonical/structural renderings. Stale English tooltip suffix and the permissions kind gap are known (MAJ-66, MAJ-67). Skill-language items 38-40 out of chunk; developer output unchanged except the known _batch_list period (NIT-4).

Casual nav Projects link via t "Projects"; repos_index heading branches; additional-dir checkbox developer-only; casual table name/label column only, unlinked; handleReposAdd grants on checkbox OR casual; git init -b main via shell.Run before registry.Add, init failure fails the add; label input both audiences with label-else-name display; catalog entries present. Pre-add mutation on duplicates and casual op-output jargon are known (MAJ-7, BLK-54). Sync/install items out of chunk.

Welcome nav gated only by initWelcome; Bootstrap card/routes present; second POST while running -> 409; status endpoint resolves newest repo-root session via peek. Log location / pid logging is known (BLK-5). Picker errors render into the path fragment (handleReposChooseFolder sets data.Error). Orchestrator items out of chunk.
No server-chunk code concerns the ACDSL policy engine; N/A for this chunk.
No server-chunk code; N/A for this chunk.
railroad-review skill and runbooks; no server-chunk code; N/A.

Welcome bootstrap form: date input prefilled today-30d with max today (computed in handleWelcome, 2006-01-02), extra-prompt maxlength 500, hx-confirm, hx-disabled-elt="find button". bootstrapEnv rejects non-YYYY-MM-DD since and quotes/newlines in extra-prompt with 400 before any spawn; empty form adds no env. audienceCasual = "casual"; isDeveloperAudience compares against it; Go no longer treats non-developer as casual (only a test name retains the old spelling, known NIT-40).

Routes GET /sessions/archive, POST /sessions/{scope}/archive, POST /sessions/archive/{name}/unarchive|delete registered, render op errors, HX-Redirect to /sessions or /sessions/archive (error-path redirect known MIN-3; archive-name shadowing known MAJ-2). Reload button, POST /sessions/reload, sessions-reload trigger and catalog entry deleted; index/scope/batch/archive handlers and handleOverview call reloadSessions first. sessions_index tabs incl. empty state, Archive folder button with confirm; sessions_archive with Unarchive/Delete (re-mining confirm) and empty state; all labels in catalog. Repo add: editable name defaulting to basename, Validate before git init; delete leaves sessions folder untouched.

handleWelcomeBootstrap spawns verifyPathPrefix + exec bash "$1" with cmd/bootstrap/run.sh, env from bootstrapEnv plus BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE and ROUTINE_MODEL from styleTestTarget; no bootstrapSkillArgs remains; detached start, 6h deadline, status polling as before (deadline process-group gap known MIN-68). Wrapper script items out of chunk.

presentationProfile.DevMode parsed from dev-mode: (literal true only); saveProfileSelection(audience, language, devMode) writes dev-mode line and deletes only for developer+en+off; isDevMode RLock accessor; handler sets devMode only for dev_mode=on and non-casual; profile.html checkbox under the audience select, disabled for casual; profilePage carries DevMode. Skill/nightly items out of chunk.
Server-chunk part: _worktree_status Verdicts tooltip documents squashed:n. Script-side items (verdict.sh, cache salt, detail annotations) are out of chunk.

statusCache.Delete/DropBranches present (fresh slice, ScannedAt kept, unknown repo no-op); handleRepoRemoveSelected drops branches only on a clean run, else fires repo-op; handleReposDelete deletes the cache entry. repoRow.Worktrees uses WorktreeCounts with one
label:count
per kind or 0. Run history: id=run-history, data-stamp rows, IIFE week bands (UTC Monday, colspan 6, 'Week a – b (n)', unknown band, newest expanded), .run-band CSS with markers. Status table now precedes #routine-configure inside .routines-layout.

Mutex-guarded presentationStore replaces the bare pointer; template funcs delegate; reload after every save. saveProfileSelection: dev+en(+devmode off) deletes (missing file no error), casual+de with empty body seeds from settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md, else front matter rewritten and body kept; writes via writeFileAtomic (MkdirAll, tmp, fsx.ReplaceFile). styleContent empty on missing file; saveStyle atomic; DefaultStylePath. Routes GET/POST /profile, POST /profile/style, POST /profile/test with POST-redirect-GET; audience/language validation 400; audience change runs skills.Sync under the skills-sync lock (ordering issue known MAJ-6); 64 KiB style cap; test runs one claude -p --max-turns 1 --output-format json via bash + token file, renders answer or error tail, missing token renders a message. profile.html has Profile/Style/Test sections per item 146.

Nav Profile link via t "Profile" for both audiences, active on page "profile"; Welcome setup tab links /profile directly above the Bootstrap block; catalog carries Profile/Developer/Casual/Business (later)/test confirm/section labels and hints. Item 149 (hook/install untouched) out of chunk.
peek-mcp transport/setup items; no server-chunk code; N/A.

Server-chunk part (item 160): sectionOverridden, claudeRows, hooksFragmentDiff and renderPermissions load the fragment via config.LoadFragment (markers expanded), and the claude revert copy expands markers through copyFileAtomic(expandMarkers). The apply direction clobbering the marker is known (MAJ-5-r2). configserver/install/plist items out of chunk.

statusEntry carries Fingerprint; Store(repoName, fingerprint, statuses); DropBranches keeps the pre-removal fingerprint; handleRepoWorktreeStatus computes the fingerprint on every load inside the status timing, serves the cache only for !refresh && fingerprintErr == nil && equal fingerprint, else re-scans and stores the new fingerprint; no TTL. handleRepoRemove and POST /repos/{name}/branches/{branch}/remove are gone; remove-selected path unchanged. Registry/Fingerprint internals are in the repos package (other chunk).
